data.close_reason: The denied-request bursts are expected negative-access probes from the lmn-staging-private-audit-* runner, not a defect. All 96 AccessDenied records in the investigated window came from audit sessions, and the bucket policy correctly enforced the private-context isolation: IAM simulation returned explicitDeny sourced from ResourcePolicy, while the curator and report-generator roles received 200 on their allowed prefixes in the same minute. KMS and VPC-endpoint causes were tested and refuted. The bursts have stopped; the last AccessDenied was 2026-09-18T04:45:42Z. The one real defect found is that the alarm counts expected audit traffic, which is tracked separately as 794e-7479-5f21-49db.
